content: Report detected Development errors to Det General Specification of Basic Software Modules AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 50 of 86 Document ID 578 : AUTOSAR_SWS_ BSWGeneral - AUTOSAR confidential - The BS W Module shall report detected Development errors to the Default error tracer ( Det ) using the service Det_ReportError with its assigned module identifier (see List of BSW Modules [1] ]) to identify itself .
